asks: What time do they lock up?
description: A fox standing upright in a faded work shirt with the sleeves rolled, entirely at home, doing nothing in particular. The shirt fits. Somebody took the trouble.
emotes: {it} scratches an ear with a back foot, which takes some organising.
{it} rolls a sleeve up one further turn.
{it} yawns, and every tooth is briefly available for inspection.
looks: The shirt is worn through at one elbow and has been mended with the wrong colour thread.
It watches the room the way something watches a field, without ever appearing to.
The tail is out of the back of the shirt and moving slightly, and it is not thinking about it.
name: a fox in a work shirt
says: I am on a break. This is what a break looks like.
You would be amazed what people leave out.
I am not doing anything. Genuinely.
